name: BelToll
law: Decree of the Ministry of Transport and Communications No. 75 of 2024-09-06 (amending its decree No. 21 of 17 June 2013), in force from 2024-09-20: EUR 0.114 per km for vehicles over 3.5 t with 2 axles, 0.142 with 3, 0.171 with 4 or more, as BelToll announced them; BelToll counts the axles of the vehicle with its trailers. Toll roads: the list of the Regulation approved by Council of Ministers resolution No. 340 of 30 April 2013, placed on the ways OpenStreetMap tags as toll roads.

sources.title: BelToll: Помощь (the number of axles includes trailers)

tolled_roads: BelToll toll roads (the list of the Regulation approved by resolution No. 340), as OpenStreetMap tags them.
